svg.title: Expected reward across on-policy learning runs with two baselines
svg.desc: Both sets of policies begin with an expected reward of 0.5. Over 60 steps, the mean reaches about 0.9 with baseline minus 0.4 and almost 1 with baseline plus 0.4. Faint lines show individual runs, some of which remain near zero under the lower baseline.
svg.text: Can a baseline change where learning ends up?
